lines.en: I walk beside you and never fall behind.

lines.zh: 我的爪子一步步跟着你的脚印。
lines.en: My claws land in your footprints.

lines.zh: 我走在你侧后方，留出位置。
lines.en: I keep at your rear flank, leaving room.

lines.zh: 我在峡谷的石头上轻快地跑。
lines.en: I run lightly over the canyon stone.
I stop to wait, then go on.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，只在你需要时张开。
lines.en: My wings stay folded until you need them.
I lift my head toward where you are going.

lines.zh: 我绕过石头，跟上你的路线。
lines.en: I go around the stone and follow your line.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the ground I cross.
I walk close so we do not get separated.
One hop and I am beside you.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，你可以靠过来。
lines.en: I walk steadily; you can lean on me.
I go ahead to test the way.
I fall back and wait for your signal.
I lie at your feet.
My head rests on my claws.
I watch you, waiting for a sign.
My wings quiver now and then.
I am here; you need not look for me.
I will not wander off on my own.

lines.zh: 风从峡谷里过来，我不怕。
lines.en: The wind comes down the canyon; I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把耳朵转过去。
lines.en: I raise my head and turn my ears.
I yawn and settle again.
I am listening to your breathing.
I know this stretch of stone.
I wait for the next stretch.
One movement from you and I am up.
I need no lead.

lines.zh: 我抬起头看你，眼里很亮。
lines.en: I raise my head to you, eyes bright.
Call once and I will come.
I push my head toward your hand.
When you touch me, I hold still.
I am waiting for you to say we go.
I know your scent now.
I nudge forward a step.
I answer with a low sound.
Where you go, I follow.
I lie a little closer.
It is good, following you like this.
Are you tired from walking?
I can carry you a stretch.
I touch you with my snout.
You need not fear what comes behind.

lines.zh: 重击放得很远，滑翔也稳。
lines.en: My heavy strike reaches far, and I glide steady.
Pat me and we go.
I understand your gestures.
We go on together.
I flinch and hold.
I can take that.
I growl and stand before you.
I give half a step and plant again.
I tilt my head, teeth showing.
I am still standing guard here.
Do not worry about me.

lines.zh: 坐稳，受伤也不会甩下你。
lines.en: Hold on — even hurt, I won't throw you off.

lines.zh: 这味道是主人常给的点心。
lines.en: That is the treat my rider always brings.
If you give it, I will eat it.
I take it gently from your hand.
That is not enough for a run.
I will want more after this.
I nudge your palm.
I like your smell too.
I eat slowly so I do not bite you.
Even after eating, I stay with you.
Bring out a little more.
This settles me.
I lift my head and wait.
This is how I know you as mine.
I have sat down at your feet.
I will not snatch; I wait for you to let go.
That was really good.
I licked my lips.
I am knocked, and I do not give ground.
I block the way, do not go through.
I brace low and hold.
A little jostling is bearable.
I block the way with my body.
My claws take the ground.
I set all four legs straight.
I turn to shield you.

lines.zh: 我低吼了一声，背上的鞍还没系紧。
lines.en: I growl once; the saddle on my back is not tight.
I do not think much about that.
I look up at you for leave.
I lie back at your feet.
I stay with my rider.
I meant nothing by it.
That is not mine to decide.
I turned my head away.
Let us get on with the road.
I wait for your next sign.
I pick it up and bring it to you.
This is yours.

lines.zh: 驯服的 Tremor，从远处重击。
lines.en: A tamed Tremor strikes from afar.
I hold it in my mouth and wait.
Too heavy; I drag it.
I found this.
I buried it.
I cannot eat this.

lines.zh: 我把它摆回原来的地方。
lines.en: I set it back where it was.

lines.zh: 我一下站起来，挡在你面前。
lines.en: I am up at once, in front of you.
I have seen the thing.
My wing leather snapped wide.
I will not let it near.
I drop low, ready to go.
You stay here and do not move.
Leave this one to me.
I will go by the high ground.
A growl came from my throat.
I have it fixed.
I set myself broadside between you and it.

lines.zh: 它转向哪边，我都跟着偏。
lines.en: Whichever way it turns, I angle with it.
I come around along the wall.

lines.zh: 我伏低等你示意，翼膜半张。
lines.en: I crouch awaiting your signal, wings half spread.
I cover your flank.
It will not get behind us.
I watch it from the high ground.
You pulled back a step.
That blow came from a distance.
I have it in my teeth.
I shoved it off with my shoulder.
I brace with my wings.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我全身的劲。
lines.en: That carried the weight of my whole body.
I landed on all four feet before I pulled up.
I am back at your side.
It has been driven back.
If it comes again, so do I.
I have been looking for you.
The moment I land, I come to you.
My wings are folded.

lines.zh: 这一带我可以带你过去。
lines.en: I can take you through this ground.
I circled the spot once.
So here is where you are.
I take my place at your flank.
The wind carries your scent.
I have come to your side.
I wait for you to choose the way.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，你替我拍了。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing, and you beat it out.

lines.zh: 落地那下我撑住了，腿有点软。
lines.en: I held the landing, though my legs are weak.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我往你那边游。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I swim toward you.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀开，离你远了些。
lines.en: The blast throws me back, away from you.

lines.zh: 那东西撕开我翼膜一道。
lines.en: It tore a slit in my wing.

lines.zh: 一股力定住我，我挣开了。
lines.en: Some force holds me; I break it.
Hunger leaves me unable to keep up.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我贴着你不敢动。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I press close, still.
The ground is gone and I cannot reach you.
